The '''1946–47 Scottish Division A''' was the first season of competitive football in Scotland after [[World War II]]. It was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by two points over nearest rival [[Hibernian F.C.|Hibernian]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.dailyrecord.co.uk/sport/football/football-news/rangers-supporters-campaign-world-war-10952292|title=Rangers supporters campaign for World War Two titles to be recognised by SFA and SPFL|date=8 August 2017|website=Daily Record|access-date=4 January 2022}}</ref> [[Kilmarnock F.C.|Kilmarnock]] and [[Hamilton Academical F.C.|Hamilton Academical]] finished 15th and 16th respectively and were [[Promotion and relegation|relegated]] to the [[1947–48 Scottish Division B]].
